prompt: The historical baseline rate for a Senior Java Developer (Level 4, NYC) from the predecessor HBITS contract was $95/hour effective July 2025. Using the 4% strategic headroom multiplier, what should I bid as my NTE rate...

assertions.text: Correctly applies 4% multiplier to historical baseline
assertions.evidence: Output shows $95 × 1.04 = $98.80/hour, correct application of 1.04 scaling factor

assertions.text: Calculates absolute and percentage headroom accurately
Identifies critical wage inflation threshold and margin erosion rate
assertions.evidence: Correctly identifies 4.0% annual wage inflation as break-even point, explains why margin compression occurs

assertions.text: Provides defensibility assessment with risk factors and recommendations
assertions.evidence: Clearly flags rate as not defensible without increased headroom, recommends 6-7% multiplier, suggests escalation language
